name: Nizervik
source:
Nizervik – is a character of Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change.
Nizervik is a young short thin long-horned dark-blue red-eyed om'verai, wearing light-purple glasses due to poor seesight, indicating his deep knowledge. He wears a purple necklace and his wing membranes are even darker. Nizervik's head is decorated with scythe-like horns.
"His brilliant mind doesn't have worthy opponents in a dozen of nearest cities. His shiny blue scales are very attractive, but due to his sharp personality, Nizervik faces problems in communicating witj tрe girls" - Ahros Amtingale.
Nizervik is a young geek with a wide knowledge over many things. Nizervik also seems to be the first one to hear about news and facts. Nizervik knows well about urban salaries and real estate.
Though Nizervik is a loyal friend of Ahros, understanding him well and giving enough mental support.
Nizervik is a Shortz's best friend. Also Nizervik seems to care enough about his sister - by lecturing her about respecting others' property.
